The structure of composition Al12Si3 (reduced formula Al4Si) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1/mcm (No. 143), with 15 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. The neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component spanning all 15 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows 12-vertex Al and Si coordination polyhedra exhibiting corner, edge, and face sharing.
